reason: The cave needs light, and fire is the available light source.
expectation: Fire will light the sheltered cave interior.

effect: The cave is lit, and painting an animal from memory is now a goal.
reaction: The dry walls make a practical painting surface.
reason: Weathered rock can contain pigments, and water may make them usable as paint.
expectation: The rock and water will make a pigment or paint.

effect: The rock and water made pigment suitable for painting the cave wall.
reaction: The pigment-making step fits the earlier description of weathered rock.
reason: The pigment should be usable at the lit cave to paint its walls.
expectation: The pigment will be used to make a painting, possibly drawing on memory.

effect: The cave now has a painted animal, and the next goal is to add stars.
reaction: Using memory automatically made the painting step straightforward.
reason: The new goal directly suggests adding the available stars to the painted cave.
expectation: Stars will be added to the cave painting.

effect: The painting now includes stars, completing that goal; making a song and passing on learning remain.
reaction: The combined animal and night sky make a coherent picture.
reason: A call is a sound, and memory could help repeat it as a song; this is a guess.
expectation: The remembered call may develop into a song.

effect: The attempted combination revealed that a call in the painted cave produces an echo, which may help make a song.
reaction: The cave echo was unexpected but understandable.
reason: Inspecting the echo will reveal how it can contribute to the remaining goals.
expectation: The echo may have a partner that helps make a song.

effect: Echo combined with Memory to make a song, completing that goal. Passing on the community's learning remains.
reaction: The remembered echo becoming a repeatable rhythm makes sense.
reason: Shared discovery is the clearest available source of knowledge to pass on; inspecting it should reveal how to teach it.
expectation: It may combine with a way of communicating or remembering the discovery.

effect: Shared discovery combined with Story to produce Teaching, completing the final goal and the chapter.
reaction: Passing on both the tested prediction and practical skills was a fitting conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making pigment and using it with memory to paint an animal was most worthwhile: the material preparation had a clear purpose, and the image communicated something absent.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding stars was straightforward but less engaging as a decision because the new goal named the needed object.

surprise.text: The failed attempt to combine Call with Memory revealed the cave echo; remembering that echo then produced a song.

arbitrary.text: Call plus Memory was a guess without a clear route to a song. The echo feedback made the eventual connection clearer.

continue.text: Yes. The cave painting and echo linked physical processes to expression in an interesting way, and I would be curious to see what comes next.
